cancel_basis: Flightradar24 RUH board count: departures + arrivals scheduled on the local day (midnight to midnight, Riyadh time), including flights still to come, identical rows de-duplicated. Percent = share of flights scheduled today.

report.title: RUH Airport Status 12:00 AM AST: HALTED
report.status_line: Airport halted since 8:10 PM, 230 minutes. No takeoff or landing since flynas XY278 from Sharm el-Sheikh at 8:10 PM (that landing ended the prior 2:05–8:10 PM halt of ~365 minutes). No takeoff since XY277 at 1:39 PM. GACA ops remain suspended after Saturday’s attack; NOTAM A3586/26: AD NOT AVBL through 11 Oct 2100 UTC (midnight AST Monday). FR24 11:35 PM: Dammam holding, including a flight originally for Riyadh. Reuters 9:40 PM restated the suspension. AP: missile struck a passenger terminal, many wounded. Cancellations remain elevated.
report.headline: Airport halted since 8:10 PM, 230 minutes — no takeoff or landing since XY278 at 8:10 PM; no takeoff since XY277 at 1:39 PM; GACA/NOTAM still suspend ops (A3586/26 through Sunday 2100 UTC); 316 flights cancelled today so far.
report.synopsis: There were 0 takeoffs in the last hour, the latest XY277 to Sharm el-Sheikh at 1:39 PM. The latest landing was XY278 from Sharm el-Sheikh at 8:10 PM, with 0 landings in the last hour. 316 flights are cancelled today (161 departures, 155 arrivals) and 57 arrivals have diverted. Yesterday, 9 October: 166 of 703 flights cancelled, 18 arrivals diverted and four halts of 45+ minutes, the longest 7:41 to 9:38 PM (no landing until 9:45 PM). No official reason has been given for the evening stop. Saturday morning: a 91-minute halt ran from 6:37 to 8:08 AM with no takeoff or landing. Saturday afternoon–evening: the board showed no takeoff or landing from 2:05 PM until flynas XY278 from Sharm el-Sheikh landed at 8:10 PM (~365 minutes). Since that landing there has been no further takeoff or landing — open halt since 8:10 PM (230 minutes at the 12:00 AM Sunday slot). Last takeoff remains flynas XY277 at 1:39 PM; prior last landing before XY278 was Air Cairo SM461 at 2:05 PM. GACA confirms King Khalid International Airport was attacked on Saturday afternoon, injuries are still being counted, and operations remain temporarily suspended until damage assessment and facility safety checks are complete. AIS/NOTAC shows NOTAM A3586/26 (NOTAMR) keeping the aerodrome unavailable from 10 Oct 19:24 UTC through 11 Oct 21:00 UTC — extended past the Flightradar24 8:35 PM post that cited AD NOT AVBL through at least 2100 UTC Saturday. Flightradar24 at 11:35 PM reported flights bound for Dammam, including one originally scheduled to Riyadh, holding away from the airfield. Reuters at 9:40 PM restated that several were wounded and operations remain suspended per the Saudi aviation authority. AP reports an official saying a missile struck a passenger terminal and wounded many; AFP hospital source said dozens injured / at least five Saudis in ICU; AFP diplomatic source said Houthis hit with a missile around 3:00 PM. Social-media death-toll claims remain unverified. No official Houthi claim for Saturday found yet. Passengers told to confirm flight status before heading to the airport. Board cancellations remain elevated; after local midnight the cancellation day rolls to Sunday 11 October.
report.gulf_footnote: No Gulf departures have left since the afternoon stop. Cancelled today include Emirates EK816, EK820, EK818, flydubai FZ848, FZ842, FZ856 and flynas XY217 to Dubai; Qatar Airways QR1167, QR1171, QR1241, QR1169, QR1165, QR1239 and QR1173 to Doha; Etihad EY552, EY556 and EY560 to Abu Dhabi; SalamAir OV206 to Muscat. Overdue Gulf flights still showing as not left: EY556 (Abu Dhabi), XY207 (Dubai), XY233 (Bahrain), QR8731 (Doha).
report.news_title: Airport halted since 8:10 PM, 230 minutes; NOTAM A3586/26 extends AD NOT AVBL through Sunday 2100 UTC; XY278 still only post-2:05 PM movement; FR24 Dammam holding; GACA/Reuters/AP unchanged.

news.title: GACA: attack on King Khalid airport; operations temporarily suspended
news.extra: published 7:32 PM AST (GACA X); last checked 11:50 PM
news.body: GACA statement: King Khalid International Airport was attacked on Saturday afternoon, 10 October 2026, amid continuing attacks on civil aviation facilities in the Kingdom. The attack caused a number of injuries, which are still being counted. Operations at the airport are temporarily suspended until damage assessment and facility safety checks are complete, in coordination with the relevant authorities; updates to follow. Covered by Sabq and Gulf News.

news.title: NOTAM A3586/26: aerodrome not available through 11 Oct 2100 UTC
news.extra: listed on NOTAC OERK page; last checked 11:50 PM
news.body: NOTAM A3586/26 (NOTAMR) for OERK/RUH: aerodrome not available (QFALC), valid from 10 October 19:24 UTC until 11 October 21:00 UTC. This replaces/extends the earlier Saturday window that Flightradar24 posted as through at least 2100 UTC Saturday (midnight AST). No GACA reopen notice accompanies the extension.

news.title: Flightradar24: Dammam holding; one flight originally scheduled to Riyadh
news.extra: published 11:35 PM AST; last checked 11:50 PM
news.body: Flightradar24 reported at 11:35 PM that flights bound for Dammam, including one that was originally scheduled to Riyadh, are currently holding away from the airfield — consistent with continued RUH unavailability and earlier diversion patterns.

news.title: AP: missile struck a Riyadh passenger terminal and wounded many, official says
news.extra: AP Breaking posted 7:26 PM AST; last checked 11:50 PM
news.body: AP reports an official saying a missile struck a passenger terminal at the airport in Riyadh and wounded many. Earlier Saturday AP cited regional officials saying the airport was attacked again, evacuated, and that air traffic stopped. Globe and Mail relays similar official accounts of a terminal strike and many wounded.

news.title: Flightradar24 / AIS: RUH AD NOT AVBL extended through 11 Oct 2100 UTC (A3586/26)
news.extra: FR24 published 8:35 PM AST; A3586/26 listed on NOTAC; last checked 11:50 PM
news.body: Flightradar24 at 8:35 PM posted the aerodrome NOTAM suspending operations at RUH through at least 2100 UTC Saturday (midnight AST): “AD NOT AVBL DUE TO PRECAUTIONARY MEASURES.” AIS/NOTAC now lists NOTAM A3586/26 (NOTAMR, QFALC) with validity 10 Oct 19:24 UTC to 11 Oct 21:00 UTC — extending unavailability through Sunday 2100 UTC (midnight AST Monday). No FR24 post yet explicitly announcing the extension; board still shows no movements after XY278.

news.title: Reuters: several wounded in Riyadh airport attack; ops still suspended
news.extra: published 9:40 PM AST; last checked 11:50 PM
news.body: Reuters reported at 9:40 PM that several people were wounded in the Riyadh airport attack and that operations remain suspended, citing the Saudi aviation authority — consistent with GACA’s earlier statement and with no reopen notice.

news.title: Gulf News / Sabq: GACA confirms temporary halt after Saturday attack
news.extra: Gulf News updated ~7:46 PM AST; Sabq ~7:40 PM UTC stamp; last checked 11:50 PM
news.body: Gulf News and Sabq relay GACA’s announcement that King Khalid International Airport temporarily suspended operations after Saturday’s attack left several people injured, with casualty numbers still being established and further updates to follow.

news.title: AFP hospital source: dozens injured at RUH; at least 5 Saudis in intensive care
news.extra: published ~6:20 PM AST; last checked 11:50 PM
news.body: A hospital source in Riyadh told AFP that dozens of people were injured at the airport on Saturday, most of them Saudi nationals, and that at least five injured Saudis were in intensive care; some patients were transported by helicopter. Saudi authorities have not publicly confirmed detailed casualty figures beyond GACA’s statement that injuries are still being tallied.

news.title: AFP diplomatic source: Houthis hit RUH with a missile around 3:00 PM
news.extra: published ~6:20 PM AST; last checked 11:50 PM
news.body: A diplomatic source briefed on the matter told AFP that Yemen’s Houthis attacked Riyadh airport with a missile at about 3:00 PM local time, calling the airport a civilian target. No official Houthi claim for Saturday was found as of this check.

news.title: Flightradar24: strike reported; last landing 2:05 PM; diversions mainly to Jeddah
news.extra: published 5:51 PM AST; last checked 11:50 PM
news.body: Flightradar24 says AP and Reuters among others are reporting a strike on Riyadh airport this afternoon. It notes the last commercial aircraft to land was at 2:05 PM local and the last departure at 1:39 PM, with flights bound for RUH diverting elsewhere, mainly to Jeddah.

news.title: BBC: RUH attacked again, evacuated after loud blast
news.extra: published ~6:07 PM AST; last checked 11:50 PM
news.body: BBC reports King Khalid International Airport was evacuated after a loud blast on Saturday, citing international news agencies, and notes travellers were told to check with their airline.

news.title: Social posts claim 6 dead / 75+ injured at Terminal 3 — not in GACA tally
news.extra: seen ~7:52 PM AST; last checked 11:50 PM
news.body: Circulating social posts attribute to Al Arabiya figures of about 6 deaths and over 75 injuries from a Terminal 3 strike. GACA has only said injuries are still being counted and has not published those numbers; treat as unverified pending official tallies.
